filter.description: The jq filter expression to apply to input JSON.

compact_output.description: If true, disables compact output (--compact-output is false), allowing pretty-printing.

raw_output.description: If true, enables raw output (--raw-output) for string values.

tab_indent.description: If true, uses tabs for indentation (--tab).

indent_spaces.description: Number of spaces for indentation (1-7) when using --indent.

sort_keys.description: If true, sorts object keys in output (--sort-keys).

slurp.description: If true, slurps all input into a single array (--slurp).

raw_input.description: If true, reads input as raw strings instead of JSON (--raw-input).

null_input.description: If true, reads no input and runs filter on null (--null-input).

args.description: List of arguments to pass to the jq program via --arg or --argjson.

args.items.description: Placeholder for list item schema. Note: items are flat objects.
